summary: Validated backend and mobile-first frontend on public preview. Backend core flows passed; frontend dark theme/onboarding/auth/add/detection/analytics/profile mostly worked, with one critical mobile viewport bug in Smart Detection modal action placement.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390x844 viewport, Add button renders below visible area (bounding box y=1005), causing tap failures while Edit/Ignore are visible.

issues: Primary CTA is not fully reachable on required mobile viewport, breaking expected action hierarchy and usability.

action_items: Fix Smart Detection modal layout so smart-detection-accept stays within 390x844 viewport without extra scrolling.
Keep Add/Edit/Ignore consistently tappable after parse modal opens on smaller mobile heights.
Harden configuration alignment: support EXPO_BACKEND_URL in frontend API base resolution to match environment contract.
critical_code_review_comments: Sensitive credentials are currently stored in /app/backend/.env in repo workspace; move to secret manager/runtime injection and rotate exposed values.
frontend/lib/api.ts reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL only; platform contract expects EXPO_BACKEND_URL path support too.
DetectionScreen modal uses fixed min-height/action layout that can push critical CTA off-screen on mobile viewport.
seed_data_creation: Created unique TEST_ email/password users via signup for backend+frontend runs; created temporary applications/detections. Backend regression test includes application cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview was available this run; onboarding and dark theme rendered correctly. Reproduce detection modal at 390x844 and verify Add CTA position/tapability after fix.
rca_of_issue: Repro: On fresh signup -> tab-detect -> parse sample text -> detection modal opens. Observed smart-detection-accept bounding box y=1005 on 390x844, while viewport bottom is 844. Root cause: modal content/action stack exceeds viewport and lacks robust internal scroll/anchoring for CTA row. Mitigation: make sheet body scrollable and pin actions within safe viewport area.
